items.title: File Einspruch against the Grundsteuerwert assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Musterweilburg eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter states the posting day (Aufgabe zur Post) as Saturday, 21.11.2026. Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a letter sent by ordinary mail counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 21.11.2026 + 4 days = 25.11.2026 (Wednesday) - no weekend/holiday shift needed for this delivery-fiction date itself. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO, the one-month Einspruch period starts the day after deemed delivery, i.e. 26.11.2026, and under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends one month later on the day bearing the same number, which falls on 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 is Erster Weihnachtstag (nationwide public holiday), so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline moves to the next working day; 26.12. is also a holiday (Zweiter Weihnachtstag) and 27.12. is a Sunday, so the deadline moves to Monday, 28.12.2026.

warnings: The letter's 'Bescheid vom' date (18.11.2026) is earlier than the printed 'Aufgabe zur Post' date (Samstag, 21.11.2026); this is unusual but is taken as printed since the letter itself bases the delivery fiction on the Aufgabe-zur-Post date.

The stated posting day, 21.11.2026, is a Saturday, which is unusual for postal dispatch; if the actual posting day differed from what is printed, the Einspruch deadline could shift accordingly - check for a postmark or envelope date if in doubt.

Public holidays used for the weekend/holiday shift are those of Hessen (the Finanzamt's seat), not Nordrhein-Westfalen where the recipient lives, per the rule that the authority's own Land applies to its delivery fiction and deadline.
